title: Download files
limitLast: Only 1 download left. Each download that starts from the beginning counts, even if you do not finish it.
limitNone: No downloads left on this link.
limitSoon: Only {{remaining}} downloads left. Each download that starts from the beginning counts, even if you do not finish it.
attachmentNote: Files are delivered as attachments and are never opened in the browser.

zip.needSelection: Select at least one file to download a ZIP of the selection.

started: Download started. Your browser shows its progress.

locked.title: This transfer is protected
locked.description: Enter the password the sender gave you to see and download the files.
locked.retryIn: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}.

notFound.title: Link not valid
notFound.description: This link does not exist or the transfer was deleted. Check that you copied the whole address.

expired.title: Transfer expired
expired.description: The files are no longer available. Ask the sender to send them again.

revoked.title: Transfer revoked
revoked.description: The sender has withdrawn this transfer. Ask them to send it again if you still need the files.

limit.title: Download limit reached
limit.description: This link has reached its maximum number of downloads. Ask the sender for a new link.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: Please wait a moment and try again.

generic.title: Could not load the transfer
generic.description: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
